Vi tri viec lam cua nguoi hoc sau khi tot nghiep: Nguoi hoc tot nghiep nganh robot va tri tue nhan tao c6 the dam nhan cac vi tri cong viec sau: - Linh vyc irng dung cong nghe Robot va tri tue nhan tao: Trong cac nha may san xuat cong nghiep tai cac khu cong nghiep - khu ché xuat, khu cong nghe cao; Cac nha may san xuat 0 to, ché bién thyrc pham, hoa chat, cac doanh nghiep vien thong, dien luc, khai thac dau khi, mo, .. + Ky su cong nghe (Engineering technologist): quan ly, cai tién quy trinh cong nghe san xuat. + Ky su ty dong hoa (Automation Engineer): Phu trach van hanh, cai tién, bao duong he thong dien, may moc, thiet bi ty dong. - Linh vyc thiét ké, che tao thiét bi, cung cap dich vu ky thuat: Trong cac cong ty thiét ke, tich hop he thong ty dong, cac cong ty phan mem nhung, thiét ke phan curng... :G NC + Ky su thiet ke (System Designer/ Specialist): phy trach thiet ke, che tao cac thiét bi va he thong tr dong hoa, tich hop va trien khai cac giai phap ty dong hoa dung robot, AI, trong theo nhu cau. + Ky su lap trinh urng dung (Programmer): lap cac chuong trinh dieu khien cho he vi xir ly, PLC, CNC, cac bo dieu khien lap trinh, he thong nhung, cac urng dung tri tue nhan tao, cac giai phap ty dong hoa sir dung robot. + Ky su du an (Site engineer): trien khai cong trinh, quan ly dr an lap dat va dua vao van hanh. - Linh vuc kinh doanh thiet bi va dich vu ky thuat: Trong cac cong ty kinh doanh va dich vu trong linh vuc ty dong; cac don vi thiet ké xay dung he thong dien ty dong cho cong trinh va nha may... + Ky su kinh doanh (Sales Engineer): Kinh doanh cac thiét bi, he thong tyr dong hoa. + Chuyen gia Tu van (Consultant): cung cap cac tu van cong nghe, thiet bi, giai phap trong linh vuc dieu khien ty dong, dan dat cac chuong trinh huan luyen cong nghe, phat trien nang lyrc nhan vien. - Linh vuc nghien curu, dao tao: Cac don vi nghien ciru he thong, cong nghe; cac don vi giao duc, dao tao, vien nghien curu, trung tam chuyen giao cong nghe... + Giang vien (Lecturer): Giang day cac mon hoc chuyen nganh Dieu khien va Ty dong h6a. + Nhan vien nghien ctru (Researcher): nghien ctru giai phap tai cac vien nghien curu, che tao may moc va cong nghé. 4.
